purpose: Teach: 一世/一丸/私用/線引き/お披露目/品位/要人/手先

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、業界に、絶対、一世、絶対、を、絶対、風靡する、絶対、製品を、絶対、目指せ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need our company to aim for products that will genuinely dominate this industry. That's what I'm asking for.
lines.style: Direct and measured. A clear attack on 「当社」. Firm jaw on the key demands. Paced to land each commitment. Ends with quiet authority, not volume.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社、本気で、絶対、社員、絶対、一丸、絶対、となって、絶対、頑張っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. Our entire team is committed to achieving that goal with everything we have.
lines.style: Respectful but steady. No excess energy. Speaks as one who carries the message. Slight nod in the voice at the affirmation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、私用、絶対、と、絶対、業務、絶対、線引き、絶対、明確にしろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I need clear lines drawn between personal matters and work. No blurring.
lines.style: Precise attack. Each phrase lands separately. Tone sharpens slightly on 「明確」. Not angry — exacting. The voice of someone who has seen the cost of ambiguity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の、本気で、絶対、お披露目、絶対、発表会、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're moving forward with the new product unveiling event now.
lines.style: Efficient and professional. Reports as though checking boxes. Warm respect underneath, but the focus stays on the task. No elaboration.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社の、本気で、絶対、品位、絶対、保て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the company's dignity is maintained in everything we do.
lines.style: Quieter than before. Weight on 「品位」. Not a demand shouted but a value settled into the air. Almost conversational in its seriousness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外、本気で、絶対、要人、絶対、ご来訪、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're coordinating all preparations for the visiting dignitaries from overseas.
lines.style: Calm efficiency. Each detail stated without strain. The tone of someone managing a checklist and aware that excellence depends on precision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業務の、本気で、絶対、手先、絶対、として、絶対、社員、絶対、誇りに思え、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want our people to take pride in their work — in being the hands that do it right.
lines.style: Softer opening, then builds to conviction. A genuine appeal underneath the direction. Lands on 「誇り」 with warmth, not just authority.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。承知いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.style: Final acknowledgment. Clear and certain. Brief because the message has been received. Respect, not reservation.
